# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_tools_doc.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Slurp garmin-mcp registers **196 tools**; 67 of them change data (in Garmin Connect, or files on the server).

- **Effect** is what the server reports to the client as MCP tool annotations: `read`, `write` (adds or changes something) or `write (destructive)` (deletes or overwrites).
- **Profiles** lists the `GARMIN_TOOL_PROFILE` values that include the tool; every tool is in the default `all`. See [configuration.md](configuration.md#tool-filtering).
- **Direct** marks tools that call a Garmin Connect endpoint themselves instead of going through a [python-garminconnect](https://github.com/cyberjunky/python-garminconnect) method. Garmin does not document its endpoints; these tools are the most likely to break when Garmin changes something.
